name: microsoft-mcp-server-for-enterprise
title: Microsoft MCP Server for IT Admins
summary: Read and manage Microsoft Entra data and read Microsoft Intune data using natural language.
description: Microsoft MCP Server for IT Admins turns natural language requests into Microsoft Graph API calls using delegated permissions. Write actions require user confirmation and a client that supports elicitation on MCP protocol version 2026-07-28.

useCases.name: Privileged access
useCases.description: Who has which directory roles, how assigned (direct vs group), and PIM status.

useCases.name: Application risk
useCases.description: Which Apps / Service Principals exist, who owns them, what permissions/SSO they use, and which are ownerless or external.

useCases.name: Access governance
useCases.description: Who has access to what (users, groups, packages); review decisions, automate joiner/mover/leaver.

useCases.name: Device readiness
useCases.description: Review device management and compliance status, join state, OS version distribution, and stale or inactive devices. Read Microsoft Intune device and policy data.

useCases.name: Provenance and investigation
useCases.description: End‑to‑end telemetry (sign‑in, audit, provisioning, network), health alerts, and SLA/availability.

useCases.name: Optimize spending & hygiene
useCases.description: License counts/usage, unused or stale apps/groups, domain configuration and contacts.

useCases.name: Directory administration
useCases.description: Create, update, and delete Microsoft Entra users, groups, and applications with user confirmation.
